caption_L1: Here a is a line diagram named Gross domestic product of Newfoundland and Labrador , Canada from 2000 to 2019 (in million chained 2012 Canadian dollars). Along the y-axis, GDP in million chained 2012 Canadian dollars is drawn. There is a linear scale from 2000 to 2015 along the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: The GDP rose sharply between 2000 and 2007, from 22,000m to 32,000m which was the peak. It then dropped slightly but has remained consistently above 30,000m since 2010. The GDP has been stable over the past decade.
